## Metrics and monitoring systems

How do I watch hosts and services?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Prometheus documentation](https://prometheus.io/docs/introduction/overview/) | Prometheus, a CNCF project | The Prometheus project's documentation, opening with an overview of the monitoring and alerting toolkit: features, components, architecture, and when it fits or does not. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Grafana OSS and Enterprise documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/) | Grafana Labs | Grafana Labs' documentation for the open source and Enterprise editions of Grafana, which queries, visualizes, and alerts on metrics, logs, and traces. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Zabbix user manual](https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual) | Zabbix SIA | Zabbix's user manual by version, with a getting-started path and links to its developer center and community resources. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Nagios Documentation](https://www.nagios.org/documentation/) | Nagios Enterprises | Install guides and references for Nagios Core, with documentation for its companion projects: the NCPA agent, plugins, Mod-Gearman, and visualization add-ons. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Icinga Documentation](https://icinga.com/docs/) | Icinga GmbH | Icinga's documentation: an installation walkthrough for a self-hosted monitoring system, core products and components, notifications, Kubernetes monitoring, FAQs, and a live demo. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [The official Checkmk User Guide](https://docs.checkmk.com/latest/en/) | Checkmk | The Checkmk user guide by version: a beginner's guide to setting up a first monitoring site, then chapters on running the monitoring software. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [LibreNMS Docs](https://docs.librenms.org/) | LibreNMS | Documentation for LibreNMS: installation, with a Docker option, auto discovery, alerting rules and transports, the API, and developer guidance for adding an operating system. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Uptime Kuma](https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma) | Louis Lam (louislam) | Self-hosted monitoring tool that checks uptime over HTTP, TCP, ping, DNS, and other monitor types and sends notifications through many services; with a live demo. | Tool | Free |
| [Telegraf documentation](https://docs.influxdata.com/telegraf/v1/) | InfluxData | InfluxData's documentation for Telegraf, an agent built from plugins that collects, processes, and writes metrics and events, compiled as a single binary. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [VictoriaMetrics Docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/) | VictoriaMetrics | VictoriaMetrics' documentation: the open source time series database, VictoriaLogs, and VictoriaTraces, plus the Enterprise edition, the cloud service, and anomaly detection. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Node exporter](https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter) | Prometheus, a CNCF project | Prometheus exporter for the hardware and operating system metrics of Unix-like kernels, with pluggable collectors; its page points Windows users to the Windows exporter. | Tool | Free |
| [windows_exporter](https://github.com/prometheus-community/windows_exporter) | Prometheus Monitoring Community | Collects metrics from Windows machines and their services for Prometheus, through collectors such as the Active Directory one; example dashboards and alerting rules are included. | Tool | Free |

## Logs and log pipelines

How do I collect, ship, and search logs?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Elastic Docs](https://www.elastic.co/docs) | Elastic | Elastic's documentation for Elastic Cloud Serverless and for Elastic Stack from version 9: solutions and use cases, platform guides, reference, and an upgrade guide. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [OpenSearch Documentation](https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/index.html) | OpenSearch, a Linux Foundation project | Documentation for OpenSearch, an open source suite for search, analytics, and observability: OpenSearch and its Dashboards, Data Prepper, clients, the benchmark tool, and Migration Assistant. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Graylog Documentation](https://go2docs.graylog.org/current/home.htm) | Graylog | Graylog's documentation by version: what Graylog is, then Graylog Enterprise, Graylog Security, Illuminate, and API Security. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Grafana Loki documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/) | Grafana Labs | Grafana Labs' documentation for Loki, the open source components of its logging stack, with an overview and FAQs on starting out, self-hosting, and labels. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Fluent Bit documentation](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual) | Fluent Bit, a CNCF project | The Fluent Bit manual: an agent that collects logs, metrics, and traces on Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD; the page points to upgrade notes. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Fluentd Documentation](https://docs.fluentd.org/) | Fluentd, a CNCF project | Documentation for Fluentd, which collects log data into one logging layer and is open source: installation by package, configuration, deployment, and plugin management. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [The Vector documentation](https://vector.dev/docs/) | Datadog | Datadog's documentation for Vector, a tool that builds observability pipelines: introduction, setup, architecture, administration, and reference. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [rsyslog documentation](https://docs.rsyslog.com/doc/) | rsyslog (Rainer Gerhards and others) | The official rsyslog documentation, which warns against outdated copies elsewhere: beginner tutorials from installation to a first configuration, then reference and troubleshooting. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [syslog-ng documentation](https://syslog-ng.github.io/) | One Identity | Documentation center for syslog-ng OSE: the administration guide, the developer guide, and how to contribute to the documentation. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Logstash](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/logstash) | Elastic | Elastic's reference for Logstash, its open source engine for collecting data from many sources, normalizing it, and sending it to chosen destinations. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [systemd-journald.service](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd-journald.service.html) | systemd | Manual page for the systemd journal service, which collects and stores log data: stream logging, journal namespaces, signals, access control, and the files it uses. | Vendor documentation | Free |

## Tracing and open standards

What do the telemetry standards say?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [OpenTelemetry Documentation](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/) | OpenTelemetry Authors | Documentation for OpenTelemetry, an open source, vendor-neutral framework for instrumenting software and collecting and exporting traces, metrics, and logs. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Jaeger Documentation](https://www.jaegertracing.io/docs/latest/) | Jaeger, a CNCF project | Documentation for Jaeger, a distributed tracing platform first released by Uber and now a CNCF project, by version, for beginners and experienced users. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Grafana Tempo documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/tempo/latest/) | Grafana Labs | Grafana Labs' documentation for Tempo, a backend for distributed tracing: searching traces, generating metrics from spans, and linking traces with logs and metrics. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [RFC 5424: The Syslog Protocol](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc5424/) | IETF | Specifies the syslog protocol for carrying event notification messages, with a layered design and a structured message format; it obsoletes RFC 3164. | Standard | Free |
| [RFC 3411: An Architecture for Describing Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) Management Frameworks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc3411/) | IETF | Describes the SNMP management framework architecture: engines, applications, and subsystems for security and for access control; part of Internet Standard 62; later RFCs update it. | Standard | Free |

## Alerting and practice

How do I alert well and respond when it fires?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Alertmanager](https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/alertmanager/) | Prometheus, a CNCF project | Prometheus documentation for Alertmanager, which deduplicates, groups, and routes alerts to receivers such as email, and handles silencing and inhibition. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Awesome Prometheus Alerts](https://samber.github.io/awesome-prometheus-alerts/) | Samuel Berthe (samber) | Collection of Prometheus alerting rules to copy, grouped by service and category, from host and hardware to databases and Kubernetes; rules are CC BY 4.0. | Reference | Free |
| [Site Reliability Engineering (Google SRE book)](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) | Google | Table of contents of Google's book Site Reliability Engineering, readable online: principles such as service level objectives, eliminating toil, and monitoring distributed systems, then practices. | Reference | Free |
| [The Site Reliability Workbook (Google SRE workbook)](https://sre.google/workbook/table-of-contents/) | Google | Table of contents of Google's Site Reliability Workbook, readable online: implementing SLOs, monitoring, alerting on SLOs, on-call, incident response, and postmortem culture. | Reference | Free |
| [Incident Response Guide (PagerDuty)](https://docs.pagerduty.com/ops-guides/incident-response-guide) | PagerDuty | PagerDuty's public version of its internal incident response process: being on call, crisis response, training, and what to do before, during, and after an incident. | Reference | Free |
| [The USE Method](https://www.brendangregg.com/usemethod.html) | Brendan Gregg | Brendan Gregg's USE Method for finding performance problems: for each resource, look at utilization, then saturation, then errors; with resource lists and suggested interpretations. | Reference | Free |
| [Healthchecks.io](https://healthchecks.io/) | SIA Monkey See Monkey Do | Cron job monitoring: each job requests its own ping address when it runs, and a late ping raises an alert; free for a few jobs. | Online service | Freemium |
